It preserves the OPEN_QUESTIONS.md single-line metadata format, correctly flips Status to Solved and sets Resolved by, and appends a properly formatted new decision entry to DECISIONS.md consistent with existing numbering. Scope is proportionate to the question (a data-model clarification), not overreaching into implementation.
